ov: The largest canine in South America, with a reddish coat and very long, slender legs. Despite its name and fox-like markings, it is neither a wolf nor a fox. It lives alone in grassland and scrub and is most active at dawn and dusk.
ht: Up to 110 cm at the shoulder
rg: Brazil, Paraguay, northern Argentina, Bolivia and far southeastern Peru; very rare in Uruguay.
df: Mostly fruit, above all the tomato-like wolf apple (40–90% of its diet), plus small animals.
fx: Its urine smells like cannabis; at Rotterdam Zoo the smell once sent police hunting for cannabis smokers.
It spreads wolf apple seeds intact in its droppings.
